summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K containing a Hong Kong Exchange regulatory announcement of a routine employee/agent share-option grant, not a special situation. On 2 October 2026 the company granted 327,889 new ordinary shares under the Prudential International Savings-Related Share Option Scheme for Non-Employees (ISSOSNE) to 362 non-employee grantees at an exercise price of HKD 85.10 per share, a discount to the HKD 95.00 closing price that day. Vesting spans three or five years, exercisable 2029-2030 or 2031-2032. No directors, executives or substantial shareholders participated. No change to corporate control, capital structure or strategy.
